Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! That's it from us. This brings an end to Zimbabwe's tour to this part of the subcontinent. The Chevrons might not have won the series, but it's one they will remember for a while. The draw was important to Bangladesh as well, as it doesn't taint their distinguished record at home in recent times. We bid you farewell. In the meantime, you can switch tabs and catch all the action from the ongoing second Test between Sri Lanka and England. Cheers!

Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudullah, reckons his players showed a lot of character in this Test and they stuck to their plans which worked. Adds that everyone is working really hard, even though sometimes it's not visible on the field. Credits Mushfiqur Rahim and Mominul Haque for their superb stand in the first innings and then goes on to praise Mehidy Hasan and Taijul Islam as well for their contributions. On his own resurgent form, he mentions that it was important for him to get that hundred as he feels more confident now. Ends by saying that this win will be a big boost for them before their series against Windies and thanks the crowd for their amazing support.

Man of the Series, Taijul Islam, says he didn't get as much support from the track as he expected, so he had to really fight for all his wickets. On the surface on the final day, he says getting some support from the other end was crucial and he got that from Mehidy Hasan, which really helped.

Man of the Match, Mushfiqur Rahim, says this win was badly needed after the loss in the first Test. Credits Zimbabwe for playing good cricket throughout this series. Praises all his players for playing their part and getting the job done when required. States that they have a good record at home in the last few years and wants to keep that up going forward. Applauds Taijul Islam and Mehidy Hasan for bowling well and adds that they are quality bowlers.

Zimbabwe skipper, Hamilton Masakadza, says he's pretty proud of how his team has played. Adds that his players have shown a lot of character which is quite pleasing to see. Praises Brendan Taylor for his outstanding knocks and also applauds Sean Williams and the seamers for bowling well on spin-friendly conditions. Reckons there are always things to learn and areas to improve, and feels that the batting in their first innings put them back, which cost them the game.

Zimbabwe will be rather disappointed with how they've fared with the bat, more than the ball. The toss did play a big factor, but maybe they could have done a bit more. Kyle Jarvis was the sole warrior with the ball in the first innings as he took a 5-fer, but none of the others could do much else. The away side lost by a huge margin, but if it weren't for Brendan Taylor's twin centuries, it would have been much worse. His stand with Moor in their first innings was the only kind of resistance provided then. The duo stitched another partnership in the final innings, but obviously it wasn't enough. You could very well say that if the others had given more support to Taylor, maybe a draw could have been salvaged.

The hosts then backed it up with a good performance with the ball. Taijul bagged another 5-wicket haul with Mehidy scalping three of his own, to restrict Zimbabwe to 304. After that, skipper Mahmudullah's finely-crafted ton and his partnership of 118 with Mithun (who scored a fifty of his own) took the hosts in a commanding position as Bangladesh set a target of 443. Their spinners once again rose to the occasion with Mehidy getting a 5-fer to his name on this occasion.

A thoroughly dominating performance from Bangladesh to level the series. It's been all them from the moment they won the toss and put themselves to bat. They posted 522 on the board in the first innings, courtesy some big knocks and even bigger stands. Haque's superb ton, with Rahim's double ton (which was the first of 2018) followed by their 266-run stand. Then Rahim joined hands with Mehidy and the duo added 144 runs between them to get to that massive score.

OUT! That's it. BANGLADESH WIN BY 218 RUNS! This is their second-largest victory in Tests in terms of runs. Mehidy Hasan wraps things up with his 5th Test 5-fer. He nicely tosses it up around off, it turns in and Jarvis gets low to play the big slog sweep. He ends up mistiming the lofted shot towards mid on. Ahmed backpedals and takes a safe catch.
FOUR! Right in the slot and that nearly goes all the way! Full ball on the stumps, Taylor throws his front leg out of the way and bangs it over mid on.
Fraction straight in line, tucked behind square on the leg side for one.
FIVE WIDES! Banged in short but it's too short, goes over Jarvis and a leaping Rahim as well. Races away to the boundary line behind.
Another one outside off, Jarvis plays and misses again.
Landed on off and it moves away ever so slightly, Jarvis is beaten all ends up as he looks to push inside the line.
Bumper from Ahmed, ducked and evaded by the batsman.
Fullish in length, tailing back in on middle and leg, Taylor moves inside the line and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Khaled Ahmed returns to the attack.
Full and quicker this time, Jarvis comes ahead and blocks it.
Full and flighted on off again, Jarvis drives towards the mid on region.
Looped up outside off well wide. Jarvis goes for a wild swipe and misses it completely.
Full and tossed up on off, driven to mid on. No run.
Kyle Jarvis is the last man in. The reason for that is, Tendai Chatara will not come out to bat due to injury. So this is the last one for Zimbabwe.

OUT! Caught by Taijul at square leg ! Tossed up on middle, Mavuta can't resist and goes for a slog. It hits the top edge and goes a mile in the air. Taijul has enough time to come under and position himself well before taking an easy catch. No intention to block at all.
Full and tossed up on leg stump, driven down to long on for a single.
Coming in with the angle on off, takes the inside edge and thuds into Mavuta's pads.

6th Test ton for Brendan Taylor! His second of this game. Equals Andy Flower for the most hundreds in international cricket for Zimbabwe. Superb batting from the maestro. He flicks this in front of square leg and the moment he realizes there's a run on, he lets out a big scream and celebrates as he jogs across. Zimbabwe might be losing this game, but this is a well-deserved consolation for him and the visiting side. Twin hundreds, first time a Zimbabwean has done it away from home. Phenomenal batting display from Brendan Taylor.
Good batting, this. Finds the gap in the mid-wicket region with a nice flick. Two more runs taken and he moves to 99 with that.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. Two runs added to the total.
Full on the stumps, blocked.
FOUR! Goes with the spin on this occasion. Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. Taylor lofts it cleanly over covers for a boundary.
The new ball is taken as soon as it becomes available.
Waits for the ball to come to him before backing away and patting it away to point with an open face.
Full outside off, pushed away in front of covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Plays for the turn when there is none. Outside off, Mavuta is beaten past the outside edge.
Almost went right through. Tossed up outside off, turns it off the rough, Mavuta comes forward to defend but the ball takes the inside edge back onto his pads and rolls inches wide of the leg stump.
Turning in from around off, kept out from within the crease.
Fires it up there, Brendan Taylor stays right behind the line and blocks it out. No single taken, surprisingly.
Full on the stumps, defended right under his nose.
Sliding down the leg side, an attempted flick shot fails to connect.
Slower through the air, on off stump, kept out without much trouble.
Spinning away from around off, pushed off the back foot on the off side.
Moves into the 90s with this. Taylor gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes with the spin as he turns it away on the leg side for no run.
Straighter one and full outside off, Mavuta is well forward in defense.

Drinks are on the field. Zimbabwe are on the verge of a loss. Taylor is holding up one end, but is running out of partners. The Bangladesh spinners have once again done the trick for their side. Only a matter of time now. Anyway, Brandon Mavuta is the next batsman in.

OUT! There's the unpredictable nature of the surface. This one just bites off the surface, comes in with extra bounce. Tiripano goes deep inside the crease but is caught by surprise due to the bounce. It goes off his glove and into Liton Das' hands at short leg. Brendan Taylor must be regretting his decision to take a single on the very first ball.
Landed around leg and it spin in, Donald offers no shot. It goes off his pad into the hands of leg slip.
Spinning on middle and leg, turned behind square leg. Taylor takes a single off the very first ball.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square to point.
Beaten! Taijul lands this around off and it spins away, Tiripano goes back to play at it but is beaten past the outside edge.
Touch short and around off, another defensive shot presented.
Goes against the turn as he flicks it through mid-wicket. A run is taken.
Fuller on the stumps, guarded out from inside the crease.

What are you doing, Brendan? Could have been another run out. He turns this to square leg and takes off. Rahim chases after the ball, gets to it quickly which forces the batsmen to abort. Just in time.
On leg stump, padded away to end the over.
Blocks it down with soft hands in front of mid-wicket for nothing.
Skidding off the surface, blocked.
Looped up on middle and leg, Donald comes forward to defend but is caught on the pads.
Donald Tiripano is the next batsman in.

OUT! He is gone. Oh, dear. A rather suicidal run out. The call was Brendan Taylor's. He works this in front of square leg and both batsmen take off after Taylor's call. Haque from mid-wicket runs to his right, gets to the ball and fires it to Rahim. He takes the ball, whips the bails off as Regis dives in. It's taken upstairs and the replays show he's short, not even in the frame.
Referral for a run out. Looks like Chakabva is gone. Doesn't look good for him.
Pitching outside leg, turning down, Brendan pads it away.
Rock solid in defense. It's kept out well from the front foot.
Works this off the inner half past the right of the short leg fielder.
Chakabva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Once again Regis presents a straight bat in response.
Sliding in from around off, met with the full face of the bat.
Good shot. Short ball, coming in from around the wicket, Taylor whips this through the big gap in the mid-wicket area. Might not go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three good runs.
Down the leg side, no shot offered.
Short ball angling across, pulled hard through square leg for one.

Big shout from Mushfiqur Rahim for a caught behind, nothing from the umpire though. No review taken either, good call this time. It spins in on leg, keeps going down, Taylor looks to flick but it brushes his pads and goes into the keeper's gloves.
FOUR! Better. More power, better timing and the placement is perfect. Brendan Taylor kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Taylor gets low, takes it on the full and sweeps it past short leg for a couple of runs.
Quicker delivery on the leg stump line, worked in front of short leg.
Worked away behind square leg and two runs are added to the total.

Ooooooo! That was mighty close. Well played in the end, but boy! Wow. Taijul puts some pace on this, it angles it on leg and skids off the surface too. Taylor just about flicks it fine down the leg side for a single.
Brendan has punched the ball off the back foot.
Quick and flat, close to off, Taylor keeps it out from the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish in length on middle and off, pushed back down the track.
Change of ends for Taijul Islam.
Attacks the stumps, Chakabva blocks by pressing forward.
Regis Chakabva to bat next.

OUT! Moor is out of here. Mehidy strikes on his return to the attack. Bowls it slower through the air, full on the stumps, PJ Moor strides forward to defend. It spins in and takes the inner portion, before flying to Kayes at short leg. Initially, he fumbles, but manages to stick it near his chest. Useful partnership of 66 comes to an end and Zimbabwe are in trouble now.
Closes the face and turns it through mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air, around off, kept out off the front foot.
Full on the stumps, blocked.

Appeal for a catch but it's turned down. Brendan Taylor doesn't even bother with any appeal. He knows he's safe. Spinning in on leg, it goes off the pads and into Mahmudullah's hands at leg slip. No bat involved.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
Flicked away through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another edge and Taylor is safe. It spins away, takes the outside edge of his hanging bat and goes past the diving slip fielder. A brace taken.
FOUR! A juicy full toss on this occasion and the result is the same. Brendan Taylor smashes it over mid on and finds the fence again.
FOUR! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Taylor lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flat, short and Taylor goes back to keep it out.

Edged but safe! Slowed it up for the first time, some drift, some more turn and it almost got Moor. On off, it turns away, Peter plays away from the body and gets an edge past the slip fielder. Two runs result.
Darted in once more, Moor drives straight to the extra cover fielder.
Taijul is bowling too fast. Needs to slow things up. It's driven to mid off.
Forced a bit square, towards point, for nothing.
Moor brings his bat ahead of his pad and blocks it away.
Quicker and full on off, dead-batted into the track.
Leans ahead and knocks this towards mid off.

FOUR! That is a really good shot. Full toss which is rightly punished. Brendan Taylor takes a step out of the crease and clears mid on with a lovely swing. Boundary results. With this, the 50-run stand is also up.
Knocks this down the ground, towards long off, for another one.
Angling in on middle and leg, the arm ball, nudged in front of square leg for a single.
Brendan Taylor plants his front foot forward, gets close to the pitch and defends.
Bowls it slower through the air and lands it fuller around off, kept out safely off the front foot.
Mominul Haque is introduced into the bowling attack.
Comes forward to this fullish length delivery and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Darts it again, on middle and leg, comfortably dealt with by Moor.
Fuller ball on off, guarded out safely off the front foot.
Goes deep inside the crease, on the back foot and defensively pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Quicker through the air again, around off, blocked down just wide of silly point.
Quick, flat and full outside off, pushed a bit square towards cover-point. Easy run collected by the batsmen.
Keeps low on this occasion, length ball outside off, PJ Moor is happy to leave it alone.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
There's the Brendan Taylor special. The maestro sees the ball landing short, and even though it doesn't rise as much as it shouldn't, manages to get low and ramp it over gully for three runs.
Angling back in from middle and off, closes the face and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Too far outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Shortish delivery rising from the surface, Taylor manages to chop it square towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the front foot once more, another tight defensive shot on offer.
Remains watchful, comes half forward and pushes it away on the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Moor gets his front leg out of the way and defends.
Pushes this quicker through the air around off, blocked in front of silly point.
Clips this fullish delivery off his pads, straight to the man at mid-wicket positioned just inside the ring.
Nice and tight, on off stump. Taylor moves a step across, gets behind the line and blocks it right under his nose.
Full in length outside the line of off stump, driven hard but straight to the man at extra cover.
Good carry to the keeper. Ahmed bowls it outside off and the batsman leaves it alone.
Shooting off the surface and angling down leg from a length, Taylor looks to flick but misses. Good take by Rahim behind to dive full stretch to his left and collect.
Landed on a length and it cuts back in slightly, outside off, Taylor covers the line and lets it through.
Moor presses forward once more and dead-bats this.
Nice and slow, full in length on off, Moor comes forward and blocks.
Pushes this through cover-point and gets to the other end.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Taylor is well forward in defense.
Full and outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, no shot offered.
Short of a good length on the stumps, blocked down on the off side.
Full delivery attacking the base of off stump, PJ Moor brings a straight blade down in response. Blocks it out.
Hurls this in the channel outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full toss tailing back in, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Length delivery angling back in, Moor looks to work it away on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Covers the line and spin before blocking it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven to covers but not in the gap.
Another front foot block.
Gets forward and blocks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Welcome back. The 2nd session is just about to begin with the players renergizing themselves with a meal and a small break. Let's hope for a good battle between bat and ball in the next couple of hours or so!
... Day 5, Session 2 ...

An engrossing session of play that could be called as either team's session. One more wicket and the hosts would've been really happy. Taylor looks quite comfortable at the crease while playing the spinners even though his partners are having problems facing the same. The post-Lunch session has been the best for batting over the past 4 days and if Zimbabwe manage to be patient in their approach and bat to the merit of the ball, there don't seem to be many demons on the pitch that can cause issues. Bangladesh, on the other hand, will be looking to knock out Taylor somehow as that is the opening that will almost lead them to victory. Will the visitors bat well and take the game into the final session or will Bangladesh quickly wrap things up? Join us in a bit for the 2nd session of Day 5!
The last ball before the break is quicker and on the pads, Moor misses it and gets rapped on the pads. The Bangladeshis appeal in vain as the ball was pitched well outside leg stump. LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Over the wicket this time, Moor defends it towards the short fine leg fielder with soft hands.
Flighted and full outside off, Moor comes ahead and smothers the spin and plays it into the ground.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Taylor guides it towards third man for another single.
Flatter ball angling in, Moor plays it towards mid-wicket off the back foot for a single.
Full and on the pads, Taylor pushes it towards deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Taps this flatter ball down in front of cover-point. Dot ball.
Outside off, Moor is on the back foot as he blocks it out.
Tossed up outside off, Moor is well forward in defense.
On the leg stump line, worked away into the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on leg from around the wicket, flicked to short mid-wicket.

Good ball to end the over! The ball lands on a crack on off stump and turns viciously to beat the outside edge of Moor's bat who was on his back foot trying to defend it. Lots of excitement in the close-in fielders.
Good ball on the stumps, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off this time, Moor drives straight to mid off.
Very full, almost yorker length, played towards mid-wicket by Moor.
Full and on off, Moor keeps it out off the front foot.
Good ball on off stump, Taylor comes ahead to defend but gets an inside edge that rolls to square leg for a single.
Taijul Islam will also have a change of ends.
Full and wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Short and quick on the off stump, punched back to the bowler by Moor.
Fuller and outside off, Moor comes ahead and defends it safely.
Shorter and quicker on middle, Moor plays it on the back foot to short mid-wicket. No run.
Fuller and on off stump, kept out by Moor.

Fifty for Brendan Taylor! Full and on middle and leg, Taylor sweeps it away for a single towards deep square leg. It brings up his 9th Test fifty. A very good innings under pressure but there's a lot of work to be done.
Mehidy Hasan to have a change of ends.
Flatter on off, Moor shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flights it up and lands it full on off, Moor leans forward and defends it to the off side.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Peter defends it watchfully on this occasion.
Ooohhh... Mahmudullah switches to 'round the wicket and serves a slider around middle and off, at 85 kph. It stays very low and Moor is lucky to keep it out from the bottom half of his bat.
Spinning back in from outside off, a bit on the shorter side, Taylor goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
Full length delivery on middle, defended back with a straight bat.
Seems like it is needed. Skipper Mahmudullah brings himself into the attack.
Good ball on off stump, Moor covers the line of the ball and defends on the front foot.
Fuller and defended more confidently on the front foot this time by Moor.
What a jaffa! The ball pitches on a short length and turns wildly after landing on a crack or something. Moor is completely beaten and the ball misses the edge luckily for the batsman.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Taylor punches it long on for a single.
Shortens the length, and the ball spins but Taylor adjusts well and defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Fearless shot from Taylor. Taijul comes over the wicket and bowls it full and on the pads. Taylor sweeps it away for a wonderful boundary.
This one spins sharply but was on the pads, balloons up after hitting the pad onto the leg side for a leg bye.
Full and outside off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Taylor loves playing the reverse sweep and is so confident every time he attempts it. Picks the ball from middle and puts it to the right of short third man and into the boundary.
Shorter outside off, Moor punches it down the ground to long on for a single.
Looped up outside off, defended off the back foot.
Mehidy flights it outside off, Moor guides it towards point and wants a run but Taylor sends him back wisely.
Full ball drifting in from around off, Taylor remains rock solid in defense.
Full delivery, attacking the stumps, tightly defended back down the track.
Stays right behind the line of this one and defends.
Works it through the gap in the mid-wicket region and comes back for the second.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Poor line from Taijul. Tosses it up on the pads, Brendan Taylor leans ahead and lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off, Moor gets the outside edge this time but it's all along the ground and in the gap towards third man. The batsmen come back for two runs.
Full and on off stump, Moor tries to defend on the front foot, gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards the point fielder.
Flighted and on off, Moor defends on the front foot.
Shorter length, turning into Moor who goes back and defends with a straight bat.
Looped up outside off, kept out by Moor on the front foot.
Full and outside off, Taylor goes for the reverse sweep and plays it really fine. The fielder at point gives chase and stops it just inside the boundary. The batsmen pick up three.
Mehidy Hasan into the attack now.
Fuller on off, Moor comes ahead to defend.
Flatter and shorter this time on middle, Moor goes back and defends.
Loopy delivery on off again, driven straight to cover.
Full and on off stump, kept out well.
Slightly shorter down the leg side this time, Moor tries to play off the back foot, misses and the ball hits his pad.
Quicker delivery that spins away slightly, Taylor drives to long off for a single.
Yorker fired in on the stumps, dug out back in the bowler's direction to end the over.
Too straight in line, on a good length, helped away down to fine leg for two more.
An attempted yorker which just misses. Ends up dishing out a low full toss which Brendan plays it to cover. A single is taken.
Just ahead of a length, close to off, blocked by coming half forward.

Trying to do a little postmortem of Sikandar Raza's wicket. In the first innings, he was bowled to a similar delivery by Taijul which was served from 'round the wicket. That time, he wasn't too forward and clearly didn't pick the variation. This time around, although he came forward, once again didn't read the same delivery. Could have played it with a straight bat by lunging forward but decided to hit his way out. Not the best option against an accurate bowler.
Back of a length outside the line of off stump, Taylor gets on top of the bounce and offers a firm punch through the covers for a double.
Outside off on a good length, let through for the keeper to collect.
Nice ball on a slightly fuller length, bounces a little more than expected. It hits the top half of Moor's bat and drops just short of silly point again. Moor is riding his luck here.
Fuller this time, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Edged but safe! Moor comes ahead to defend this full ball outside off and gets a leading edge that just falls short of silly mid off.
Full and on off stump, kept out by the batsman.
Nice ball on the stumps, Moor gets his bat in front of the pads and defends well.
Good bowling here from Taijul! Makes Taylor drive in the air, luckily for him it falls in no man's land. The batsmen run one.
Back to a good length and outside off, Moor just watches as it goes through to the keeper.
FOUR! Beautiful drive from PJ Moor. Full and outside off, Moor gets it off the middle of the bat and drives it towards the cover boundary.
On a length and well outside off, Moor smartly decides to let it go this time. Patience is the need of the hour.
Poor shot from Moor! Outside off and on a good length, Moor tries to drive it and gets beaten. He could've left it alone.
Outside off and fuller this time, Moor leaves it alone.

Full and on off stump, Taylor looks to drive straight but gets the inner half of the bat and the ball goes in the air towards mid-wicket. It was well away from short leg. The batsmen pick up a single.
Peter Moor walks into the middle next. All on him now to get in there and fight it out with Brendan Taylor.

OUT! GONE! Taijul picks up his second of the innings, his 18th of the series, making it the best outing for him in a Test series. Sikandar Raza departs. The bowler comes from around the wicket and loops it up on the stumps. There is some turn away as Raza looks to whip this away through mid-wicket. Is a bit early into the shot and he mistimes it to the left of the bowler. Taijul gets low and takes a sharp catch. Zimbabwe sink a bit deeper.
Flatter again and on off, Raza defends on the front foot.
Very wide outside off, Raza just lets it go.
Good ball! Gets Taylor to drive away from his body but the shot is controlled and along the ground in the gap towards point for a single.
Fuller and outside off again, Taylor keeps it out.
Full and looped up on off stump, Taylor comes ahead to defend it into the ground.
In the channel wide outside off, Raza shoulders arms.

FOUR! Shot! No stopping this one. Raza stands tall inside the crease, fetches a short ball from outside off and pulls it with authority in front of square leg for a cracking boundary. This shot will give a lot of confidence to Raza.
Lands it full and around off, Sikandar leans forward and strokes it through mid off for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, a hint of inward shape, Raza watches the line closely before making a leave.

Chance of a run out missed! Good reaction shown by the short leg fielder. A delivery which has been angled into the batsman from 'round the wicket. Raza gets on the front foot to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes off his pads to Mominul on a bounce. Raza has come out in the process and sensing that, Haque has an immediate shy at the striker's end. Misses. Could have been curtains for Raza had he found the stumps.
Good ball! Khaled is getting good pace here and hurried Raza with a length delivery on off stump. Raza defends it somehow.
Full toss on off stump, Raza plays it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Raza comes ahead and defends presenting the full face of the bat.
Quick and slightly fuller on middle, Raza defends on the front foot.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Raza goes back and punches it in the gap through cover this time for another couple.
Shorter and spinning away, Raza rocks back and cuts it square on the off side for a couple.
Full and on off stump, Raza keeps it out.
DRINKS BREAK.. A good morning session for the hosts but they would've liked a couple of more wickets. Taylor doesn't seem to be troubled too much till now. Zimbabwe will look to just keep on batting!
Length ball outside off, no need to play this one.

Not out! Review lost by Bangladesh. A very poor review all things considered since it looked to be missing leg stump to the naked eye. The ball was full and angling down the leg side, hits Taylor on his pads as he was looking to flick it towards square leg. Looked as if the bowler asked his captain to take the review. Not a good call.
Huge shout for an lbw! Not given. Seems to be going down leg. But Bangladesh have decided to review it. Let's find out...
Good length and outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to this one.
Short of a good length, hits Taylor on his thigh pad and falls down to short fine leg.
Good length outside off, Taylor wants to cut it away but doesn't make a good connection. The ball rolls towards cover.
Good length ball just outside off. Keeps slightly low. Taylor defends off the back foot.
Khaled Ahmed is the first change in the bowling this morning.
Full and on middle again, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good ball on middle stump, Raza defends it again.
Full and outside off, Raza keeps it out off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Taylor plays it towards mid-wicket and sets off for one.
Looped up outside off, driven away towards sweeper. The batsmen run two.
Full and on off stump, Taylor defends to cover.
Good length ball outside off. Was a little slower too. Raza defends it onto the ground off the back foot.
Full and on the off stump, Raza keeps it out with a straight bat.
Well bowled! Brings this one in with the angle but slightly moves away after pitching. Raza leaves it at the last moment.
Fuller and on off stump, the batsman drives it straight down the ground and picks up a single.
Switches to around the wicket, drops this one outside off and on a length. Taylor leaves it alone.
Mustafizur to continue. Lands this one on a length and on middle, Taylor defends on the back foot.
Angling in on middle and leg, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Goes full on this occasion, Sikandar Raza plays a bit of an expansive drive, finds the man at point.
Goes on the back foot to this one and punches it into the off side.
Another one fired outside off again, Raza has nothing to do with it.
Spinning away from around off, nice loop on it, left alone.
Almost. Quick, flat and skidding onto the stumps, Raza is almost done in by the pace. Does just enough to bring his bat down and get an inside edge onto his pads.

WOAH! Fizz comes around the wicket and drops it slightly short of a length outside off. The ball rares up from nowhere and is in front of Taylor's face as it passes him. He does well to get out of the way. Could've easily got the glove and lobbed up.
Full length and on off stump, Taylor plays it straight back to the bowler on the front foot.
Fuller and on middle, Taylor keeps it out with a straight bat.
Length ball at the pads this time, Taylor tucks it behind towards fine leg for a couple. Good running there!
Loose from Taylor! Chases after a very wide and full delivery outside off. Misses it completely. Unnecessary!
Length delivery angling across the right-hander. Taylor decides to let it go.
Shorter and quicker this time. Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Leading edge but safe! Raza comes ahead to defend a not-so-full delivery. The ball runs safely to point. No run.
Short ball and fast on middle, Raza goes back and defends it.
Flatter ball on off stump, defended on the front foot.
Full and on the pads, Taylor tucks it away behind square on the leg side for a run.
Looped up on off stump, draws Taylor forward who drives it mid off. No run.
It's a length ball on the pads this time, Taylor plays it away to deep square leg to keep the strike with a single.
Fuller length and on off stump to Taylor, seems like a plan. Taylor defends it well though.
Outside leg and short this time, Raza plays it down to fine leg for a single. It also brings up the 100 for Zimbabwe. Runs will be the last thing in their minds at the moment though.
Short of a good length and on the hips, defended off the back foot by Raza.
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a delivery from the Fizz out of nowhere! The ball lands on a length just outside off, moves in slightly after landing. Completely squares up Williams who plays for the wrong line while trying to defend. The ball hits the top of off stump. This wicket should pump up the Bangladeshis.
Bowls it way wide outside off, Williams allows it through to the keeper.

Field placement for this over - Two gully fielders, a short mid-wicket fielder and a short cover fielder. So, the line is going to be outside off and he will be looking to bring it in from that angle.

Really good looking drive again in the gap between cover and mid off. The ball doesn't reach the boundary as the fielder at mid off chases it all the way till the rope and shows off his footwork to save a couple of runs for his team.
Fuller and on the pads, played with the angle toward mid on.
Slightly drifting onto the pads this time, defended towards short mid-wicket this time.
Similar ball and similarly played again.
Full and on off stump, kept out by Taylor.
FOUR! Very full and quick this time, Taylor quickly positions himself and drives it away for a boundary through extra cover.
Shorter this time, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Williams, a leg stump half volley and the batsman just picks it and puts it for a boundary towards deep square leg. No fielder present in the deep there.
Around the wicket to the left-hander as well, the ball is on a length and on the pads, defended on the back foot straight back to the bowler.
Driven in the gap to the left of cover, ball was full and outside off. Taylor picks up a single.
Good ball outside off again, slightly overpitched. Defended on the front foot towards cover.
Slightly full and outside off, driven hard but straight to mid off by Taylor.
Similar delivery, defended on the back foot this time.
Flatter ball on off stump this time, Williams wants to punch it but gets an under edge to short third man. No run.
Flighted and on off on a good length, gets the inside edge of Williams' bat but drops just a little away from short leg.
Full and flighted outside off, Williams comes ahead and defends.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a brace.
Fuller and quicker on off stump, Sean prods forward in defense.
Full and on off, Taylor defends to short cover on the front foot.

In the air but falls just slightly short of short leg! Good length ball on the pads but holds up in the pitch. Taylor is into his shot quickly and the ball goes in the air toward short leg but just drops in front of him.
Slightly full and on the pads this time, flicked away by the batsman to deep square leg for a couple.
Around the wicket now, has a leg gully in position. Good length ball outside off, defended by Taylor to short extra cover.
Lovely shot! This time Rahman fires in a fuller length delivery on off, Sean stays back and brings down a straight bat to drive it past mid off. They take three runs.
Angles in a length ball on off, staying a bit low, Williams keeps his eyes glued on the ball, crouches a bit and then blocks it safely. Not an easy pitch now.
Taijul is relentless in his line and length, Taylor defends it again. This is good bowling!
Taylor has had enough of defending and lofts this one over extra cover for a couple of runs.
Full and quick on off stump again, Taylor defends on the front foot.
Quicker this time on off stump, Taylor plays it with the spin to point. No run.
Similar length on off stump, defended again.
Around the wicket to the right-hander, good ball on off stump, turns away very slightly, Taylor defends watchfully.
Fuller ball this time, Williams comes and defends on the front foot.
Length ball on off stump, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Things are happening here, looks like a cutter. The ball rips inside after landing and bounces a bit more to hit Williams' thigh pad. Lobs to slip.
Good length outside off stump, left alone.

That was close! The ball lands on a good length on off stump, skids on after pitching and gets the leading edge which runs through fourth slip and gully. The batsmen pick up a couple. Lucky for Williams.
Short of a good length and on the hips, Taylor gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball rolls to deep fine leg for a leg bye.
Faster ball on off stump and full, Sean comes ahead and defends it.
Shorter length this time but quicker, Williams defends on the back foot.
Similar ball again, Williams shoulders arms again.
Flatter and quicker well outside off, left alone again.
Flatter and wide outside off, Williams lets it go.
Flighted on a good length outside off, Williams comes ahead and defends to cover.
Taijul Islam to bowl from the other end.
Good length ball on the pads to end the over, it is played on the front foot to short mid-wicket.
Similar length and line again, defended with a straighter bat this time.
Back to a good length and on leg stump this time, defended to short mid-wicket off the back foot by Taylor.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off. No run.
Slightly fuller and angling across again, defended on the front foot this time.
Good length and on the middle stump to start off with, angling across, but well defended by Taylor.

We are ready to get underway. Big day for both teams. Brendan Taylor and Sean Williams walk out to continue from Day 4. A lot rests on this pair if Zimbabwe are to get anything from this game. Mustafizur Rahman to take the ball first up on this final day.

Pitch Report - Tino Mawoyo out in the middle says the ball has really started to turn and bounce and the Zimbabwean batsmen had a hard time batting towards the end of Day 4. Adds that the wicket is fresh, there's a bit of dampness from the covers and it won't turn as much in the morning. Continues saying that there's going to be uneven bounce, so it will be difficult for the visitors' batsmen. Ends by saying that Brendan Taylor will be the key and that the others will have to support him well.

Looking forward to today, we can expect most of the overs to be bowled by Bangladesh's wrecker-in-chief this series, Taijul Islam. The pitch has started to play tricks and it should be a very difficult task for the visiting batsmen to survive the trial of spin from Taijul, Mehidy and Mahmudullah (if needed). As for Zimbabwe, Taylor will hold the key along with Williams, Moor and Raza, who should give him support if they want to win their third-ever away Test series. Will the hosts win the match and share the trophy or will Zimbabwe hang on for a draw? We'll soon find out.

Hello and welcome to Day 5 of the 2nd Test between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe, also the last day of the long tour! The hosts are currently trailing 0-1 in the Test series but are in prime position to share the trophy by winning today. Day 4 saw Bangladesh batting for the second time in this Test, they piled up 224 runs in the innings courtesy a century from their skipper, Mahmudullah, and made sure that a Zimbabwe victory is more or less off the cards. The home side even picked up a couple of Zimbabwean wickets towards the fag end of the day to be in a good position.
... Day 5, Session 1 ...

The hosts are on the verge of drawing this series to 1-1 but the visitors will be disappointed with the way they have played in this Test. Can they provide a resistance or fightback? We hope for a good contest. Join us on Thursday which will be the last day of this series at 9.30 am local (0330 GMT). Goodbye for now. Take care.

367 runs on a Day 5 track is not easy but even for Zimbabwe to save this Test, it will not be easy considering the turn and bounce on this pitch. Taylor's experience will be crucial again. The hosts, on the other hand, would be looking to wrap it up quickly tomorrow. The pitch has started to turn for the spinners. It will be interesting to see how much they exploit out of this. The spinners will play a major role on DAY 5. Taijul will be their main bowler who can strike.

It has been a good session for Bangladesh because they got both the openers dismissed. The visitors would have wanted both the openers to stay till the end of the session but that did not happen. The hosts could have got them early if they had held on to their catches. But today was their day.  They lost four quick wickets in no time but then, Mahmudullah and Mithun took the game away with the skipper's hundred before Tea being the icing on the cake.
The umpires have a look at the light and are not too happy. They offer the light to the batsmen and they are off. It is also STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Flighted delivery outside off stump, the batsman drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up on off stump, Williams defends off the front foot.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Williams defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Taylor drives it towards covers. They pick up a single.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Taylor blocks it well.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Goes back and defends it from his crease.
Oohhh... comes forward, looks to flick but the ball spins away takes the leading edge and flicks through the vacant silly point region.
Short and outside off, Williams looks to cut but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
BYE. Full and outside off, Taylor looks to defend but the ball spins away past the outside edge but Rahim fumbles. A single to backward square leg.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Taylor defends off the front foot.
HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Tossed up on off stump, Taylor comes forward to defend but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full again, Taylor comes forward and blocks.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Williams gets an edge over the short leg fielder. The ball bounced and had gone towards the leg side. The batsmen pick up a single.
Tossed up on off stump, Williams defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full again, well blocked out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and down the leg side, Taylor looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off something to short leg and there is a huge appeal, but in vain.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. One run added to the total.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sean Williams walks in at number 4, replacing Chari.

OUT! LBW! The decision stays as it is and Zimbabwe lose both - Chari and a review! Poor shot by the opener. Flighted delivery outside off stump, Chari goes for the paddle sweep but misses it and gets rapped on the pads. Taijul appeals loudly and umpire Dharmasena gives it out after a long thought. Chari has a chat with Taylor and then decides to go for the review. Impact is in line and wickets hitting. Zimbabwe lose their review. They have lost both their openers. He was looking good out in the middle, probably over-attacking cost him.
Chari has been adjudged LBW now! He has taken the review though...
Comes forward and defends it watchfully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, watchfully  defended.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Taylor defends off the back foot.
Bowls short, Chari pulls it towards mid-wicket. They take a single.
Flighted delivery again on middle stump, Chari defends off the back foot.
Bowls full on leg stump, the batsman hits it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, Taylor defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Taylor defends off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off stump, the batsman again offers no shot.
Drifts away from the batsman, Chari lets it go.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Chari defends off the front foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Brendan Taylor walks in at number 3, replacing his skipper.

OUT! This time the catch is taken! Sharp catch by Mominul Haque. The stand has been finally broken. Tossed up on middle stump, Masakadza tries to defend off the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads and it lobs to short leg. Mehidy has delivered the first strike for Bangladesh. It has taken a long time coming, though had they taken their opportunites earlier, they could have picked up more wickets by now.
A short ball, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up on middle stump, the batsman plays a slog sweep towards square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Terrific shot. Bowled short and flat, Chari pulls it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Chari defends off the front foot.
Full and outside off, HM looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes wide of first slip. Two runs taken.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, Hamilton looks to drive but the ball spins away and goes to first slip.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Chari defends off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, the skipper flicks it towards the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, Chari sweeps it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, the skipper drives it towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Masakadza gets it off the thigh pad.
Tossed up on leg stump, the skipper pushes it towards the leg side.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, well defended.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Now this one spins the other way, left alone.

HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Tossed up on middle stump, Chari tries to defend of the front foot and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. It was possibly going down leg.
Wide outside off stump, the skipper shoulders his arms to this one.
Good length delivery outside off stump, the skipper offers no shot.
Length delivery on off stump, Hamilton lets it go.
Wide outside off stump, Masakadza lets it go.
Length delivery on off stump, Masakadza defends off the back foot.
Full outside off stump, the skipper drives it towards covers.

DRINKS BREAK. What an hour of play for the visitors! They have been put under pressure and have had a couple of lifelines too. But the important thing is that they haven't lost any wicket so far. They will hope to continue the good work and keep the damage to zero or as minimal as possible till Stumps.
Flatter and quicker on the pads, punched to mid-on. No run. The umpire signals for Drinks to come onto the field.
Full and turning away, Chari goes for the lofted shot over extra cover. It's just outside the fielder's reach and the batsmen come back for two.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Landed outside off, Chari looks to defend but the ball pitches and then spins away to beat the outside edge.
Taijul Islam is back on.

Fuller length ball outside off stump, driven to sweeper for a run. This brings up the 50-run stand between these two. It's a solid start for Zimbabwe. And this is their first 50-run stand for the opening wicket in 8 innings. The previous one came way back in October 2017 against West Indies.
Full and outside off stump, the skipper defends on the front foot to point.
Oooh! Almost played on! Masakadza brings his bat down very late to defend this length ball just outside off, gets the inside edge and the ball bounces just to the side of the stumps.
Length ball angling onto the middle stump, Masakadza drives it to mid off. No run taken though.
Full and outside off. Leaves it alone this time.
Full and outside off, Masakadza drives it to short cover. No run.
Full and flighted outside off, defended by Chari on the front foot.
Flatter and quicker going down off with the angle. Chari gets behind it and defends off the back foot.
On a good length and middle, Masakadza comes down the pitch and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Looped up on middle. Kept out safely.
Flatter and quicker at the pads, the skipper flicks it but it hits forward short leg. No run.
Around the wicket, full and flighted on off. Defended on the front foot by Masakadza.
Full and on the pads, flicked away by the batsman towards deep square leg for a couple of runs. Easy pickings these for Zimbabwe.
Good length ball and moving away slightly, Chari shoulders his arms to it again.
Good length and wide outside off, left alone by Chari.
Fuller this time, played off the front foot towards sweeper again for a run.
Wide outside off and on a length, Masakadza stands tall and punches it to the right of sweeper and picks up a couple of runs.
Good length ball on off stump, defended off the back foot by the captain.
Ariful Haque is into the attack.
Full and outside off, the batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full toss on the pads, the skipper pushes it to deep mid-wicket for another run.
Full outside off, Chari goes down and sweeps it away to deep square leg for a single.

Full and outside off, Masakadza comes down the wicket and hits it straight to mid on and runs for a single. The fielder at mid on has a shy at the stumps but the throw is well wide. Would've been interesting if he had hit.
A carbon copy of the previous ball and a carbon copy of the defense too.
Mehidy bowls the first one flighted outside off. Masakadza comes ahead and defends.
Mehidy Hasan introduced now.
Full and on the pads, Chari drives through mid-on for another couple of runs. Expensive over from Khaled, he has been all over the place in this over. 11 from it.
Overpitched again, Masakadza drives it down the ground towards the long off boundary, the ball doesn't have the legs to reach the fence. They run three.
Short and aimed at the head, Masakadza just ducks and lets the ball go.
FOUR! Delightful on drive from Masakadza! Full and on off stump, the skipper drives it all along the ground to long on for four!

Full and on off stump, Chari hits it straight back at the bowler, who tries to get down to stop it but misses and gets hit on the shin. The batsmen pick a single to mid off as the ball changes direction after hitting the bowler.
Full and angling into the pads, Masakadza flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and turning away, Chari tries to get behind the line of the ball and defend, but it takes an inside edge onto the pads and falls tantalisingly short of slip.
Fuller this time on middle, defended straight back on the front foot.
FOUR! Good shot here from Chari, rocks back to a short of a length ball and punches it through cover for a four.
Shorter and on middle, Chari defends off the back foot.
Good length ball but quicker this time, he pushes it on the off side to point. No run.
Flighted on middle. Chari defends on the front foot.
Short and wide outside off. Chari frees his arms and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen run through for a single.
Full and outside off, seams in a little after landing. Chari decides to leave it alone.
Fuller and aimed at middle stump, the batsman plays it back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Good bowling by Khaled here! This one is quicker and at the stumps, hurried up Chari who manages to get an inside edge that saves him.
Shorter ball, also slower in pace. Chari wants to pull it away but is through his shot even before the ball reaches him. The ball goes to Rahim on the bounce.
Good length ball and outside off, Chari shoulders his arms to it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! He continues to attack Taijul. Full and outside off, Chari comes down the track and lofts it over long off!
On a length around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Around off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! SMASH! Full and outside off, Chari comes forward and lofts it over mid on, one bounce and into the fence!

EGDED BUT DROPPED! Again! Regulation catch dropped and more disappointment for the youngster. 3rd catch dropped off his bowling and he's still left yearning for his first Test scalp. Good ball outside off, seaming away after landing, Masakadza just hung his bat outside and gets an outside edge that carried fast and at a good height to Mehidy at gully. However he wasn't able to rise up quickly and hence, the ball fell out of his hands.
Almost the same as last ball, the ball just bounces a bit more. The skipper is surprised as he tries to defend and the ball hits him high on the bat.
Khaled is bowling it in good areas. Just outside off and good length again. Solid defense by Masakadza though.
Slightly fuller and outside off, left alone again.
Good ball! On a good length and seams in after landing. Masakadza lets it go but it was closer to the off pole than he anticipated.
Good length ball on off stump, Masakadza defends it to cover.
Full and on middle again, Chari comes ahead and defends with the full face of the bat.
Full and flighted outside off stump, Chari raises his arms to let it go through.
Shorter and turns away from the batsman. He pushes it to point. No run.
Fuller and slightly flighted outside off. Chari defends it by getting behind the line of the ball.
Good length ball on the stumps, Kept out by Chari.
Short and delivered from very wide of the stumps by Taijul. Chari makes room and punches it through cover for a double.
Good length and outside off this time. Masakadza drives it confidently through cover for a couple. Good shot that!
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
A bouncer now, Hamilton sways away.
On a length outside off, watchfully left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Khaled Ahmed to bowl now.
A short ball, down the leg side, pulled through square leg for a single.
Outside off, Hamilton comes forward to defend but the ball rips past the outside edge.
Full and flighted outside off again, the skipper just lets it go through this time.

NOT OUT! The decision has been overturned! Zimbabwe and Masakadza heave a sigh of relief! Flighted and pitched outside leg, Masakadza came forward to defend the ball but the ball missed his bat and went off something to silly point. Bangladesh appeal and umpire Dharmasena upheld the appeal. The captain was confused a bit, as to whether he was adjudged LBW or caught. He has a long chat with his partner and then eventually signalled for the review. Replays show that the ball just grips and turns viciously as it hits a rough spot on the pitch. No evidence on the Ultra Edge. The third umpire does not check for LBW but even if he had, that seemed to be pitching outside leg stump.
Fist wicket down! Or is it? Hamilton Masakadza has been given out caught at silly point. The skipper looks bemused at first but then eventually takes the review.
Full and on middle stump, defended safely on this occasion.
BEATEN! Similar ball but grips and turns a bit more this time. Masakadza tries to defend but goes past his outside edge. Lots of excitement among the close-in fielders.
Flighted on middle, Masakadza defends.
Back to over the wicket for the last ball, Chari defends on the back foot.
Short of a good length this time, aimed at the ribs, Chari wants to play the pull but misses it completely as the ball doesn't bounce as much he expected it to. Gets hit on the left rib.
Length ball drifting down the legside this time, the captain plays it down to fine leg for a run.
Good length ball on off stump, rock solid defense by Masakadza on his front foot.
Wide outside off again, left alone again.
Good length outside off stump, the skipper shoulders his arms to it.
Full and flighted this time, Chari looks to defend straight but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full and on middle stump, defended on the front foot.
Shorter and wide outside off, Chari cuts it straight to backward point. No run.
Short and slightly turning away, Chari punches it in the gap square on the off side for a couple.
Full and on the stumps. The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter and quicker this time, defended straight back to the bowler.

Good length ball  starting on middle stump. The batsman looks to play the flick but misses and the ball raps him on the pads. Appeal from the bowler and close-in fielders but not out says the umpire. Must be going down leg with the angle. A leg bye has been taken down to fine leg.
Good length and outside off again. Left alone again.
Around the wicket for this ball, outside off and on a length. Left alone by Chari.
Outside off, moving away, left alone.
Gets right across and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
On a length around off, solidly defended.
On the pads this time, the skipper defends it to short mid-wicket. No run.
Full and on middle stump, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
What a ball! Turn and bounce from Taijul with the new ball. Masakadza wants to defend it but it beats his outside edge and goes to Rahim.
Full and flighted on the pads this time, the skipper defends it onto the ground.

DROPPED! Second ball from Taijul and he already had a chance to pick up a wicket! Drives the batsman onto his front foot and gets the outside edge that goes to first slip who can't hold on to it. Chari played that very far away from his body. The batsmen run one.
Short and wide outside off, turns away slightly. Masakadza cuts it in the gap to deep point and picks up a single.
Taijul Islam to bowl with the new ball from the Runner End.
Ends the over with a bouncer. Chari just ducks and avoids it.
Good length ball outside off, low bounce this time. Chari watches as it goes through to Chakabva.
Good length ball on the off stump, defended solidly by the batsman this time.
Length ball outside off, well left by Chari. Good carry on the new ball. The ball holds its line.
Good length ball on leg stump again, the skipper tries to defend but he gets a thick inside edge to deep square leg for a single.
Starts off with a ball on the pads, slight shape. Masakadza defends it to short mid-wicket.
